label: Bible Study
prompt: And lead us not into temptation, but _____ us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verse: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
note: The Lord's Prayer's last request — then the closing praise: thine is the kingdom, the power, the glory.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Be not afraid of their _____: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verse: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
note: Young Jeremiah protests he's only a child; God says don't fear their faces — I am with thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy _____, and walk.
verse: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
note: Thirty-eight years by the pool, then three commands from Jesus: rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And take the _____ of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verse: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
note: The armor's last pieces: a helmet for the head, and the only offensive weapon in the kit — the word.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a _____, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verse: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
note: The high priest's gold plate was engraved like 'a signet' with a four-word motto: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
